summary: Oil jumps again (Brent ~$104-108, Gulf shipping attacks) and futures are lower, but this is the same set-up as 2026-10-07: the bearish move is already in the pre-market gap, and yesterday's put lost 97% while SPY rose from the open. Skip rather than pay for a move that already happened.
reasons: SPY pre-market 773.90 (-0.43% vs 777.22 close); QQQ -0.70%; futures S&P -0.5%, Nasdaq -0.7%, Dow -0.9% (Yahoo live)

Oil: USO +3.9% pre-market; Brent about $104-108, WTI about $91 (+3.6%), on more attacks on shipping in the Gulf / Strait of Hormuz, reversing Wednesday's post-IEA dip. TLT -0.3% (yields up a little), UUP flat
FOMC minutes came out at 14:00 Wednesday; no clear reporting on the yield reaction found. No CPI/NFP today; CPI is 10-14

Lesson from 2026-10-07 (EVOLUTION.md): with the bias matching the pre-market gap, SPY was -0.25% close-to-close but +0.18% open-to-close, so 0DTE puts bought after the open lost ~97%. Same pattern today: macro gap down, bias would only buy the move that already happened. Hypothesis 3 in SUNDAY_TESTS.md tests this properly
Pre-market weakness is semis-led: INTC -2.5%, MRVL -2.6%, AVGO -1.7%, AMD -1.6%, MU -1.6% (after +4% Wednesday), TSM -1.4%; energy up (XOM +2.2%); GOOGL +0.5%, AAPL +0.1%
